lines: No delivered package names a framework as its peer.
Delivered libraries: 12, jquery 3.7.0, axios 1.4.0, core-js 3.32.0, semver 7.5.4, @nextcloud/axios 2.4.0, style-loader 3.3.3, and 6 more.

88 delivered files carry no source map, 4 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
1 package is imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
